import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { nodes } from "../../../backend/schema/nodes";

export const nodesCms = customizeTable<typeof nodes>("nodes", {
    listFields: ["nodeId", "version", "timestamp", "visible", "latitude", "longitude"],
    fieldOrder: [
        "nodeId",
        "version",
        "timestamp",
        "visible",
        "latitude",
        "longitude",
        "tile",
        "changeset",
        "redaction"
    ]
});
